display_name: Moonbloom KIE Image (Grok Imagine 2.0 Edit, paid)

prompt.tooltip: Positive prompt (from the Design node). KIE limit: 8000 characters. Negative prompt: none: the model has no negative field, the Avoid list stays inside the prompt text.

aspect_ratio.tooltip: KIE allows: 1:1, 2:3, 3:2, 16:9, 9:16, auto. Offered: the Etsy formats this model supports.

dry_run.tooltip: ON (default): only checks the request and shows the LIVE price, nothing is sent and no credits are spent. OFF: pays KIE credits.

reference_labels.tooltip: ON: the long labels 'REFERENCE_IMAGE_1 / REFERENCE_IMAGE_2 ...' are put before the prompt (the app's full prompt needs them). OFF: the prompt itself says what image 1 and image 2 are (the brief prompt does).
